annotations.title: Turn the person's own floor plan into a 3D wooden house

description:
Builds a 3D wooden house from the rooms of a person's own floor plan (photo, sketch, PDF page or drawing). The rooms are read from the drawing and sent as rectangles; Geoniks builds the walls, doors, windows, floor and roof and returns a 3D view link, the floor plan + elevations PDF and an "edit in Geoniks" link.
Input format:
• Units: metres, from the dimensions written on the drawing (converted from cm/mm/feet). Without dimensions on the drawing, the overall size is needed.
• Coordinates: origin at the top-left corner of the drawing, x to the right, y downwards — exactly as the drawing looks.
• Every room is a rectangle {name, x, y, width, depth}. Rooms that touch must share exact edges (walls are drawn on the shared edges). Split an L-shaped room into two rectangles with the same name. Include halls, corridors, storage and terraces only if they are inside the walls.
• openings: each door between two rooms as {type:"door", room, to}; each outside door or window as {type, room, side} where side is top/bottom/left/right as drawn; position 0–1 along that wall (default 0.5), width in metres. Missing doors and windows are added automatically.
Single storey only. For drawings too unclear to read, the Geoniks team builds the model by hand at https://www.geoniks.com/floor-plan-to-3d.

country.description: Optional country (name or ISO code) for a price estimate.

position.description: 0–1 along the wall part (left→right or top→bottom). Default 0.5.

side.description: Outside wall side of the room, as drawn.

to.description: Other room for a door between two rooms.

roof.description: Roof shape if shown or asked for. Default gable.

name.description: Room name as written on the plan, e.g. "Living room", "Bedroom 1", "Bathroom".

x.description: Left edge, metres from the left of the drawing.

y.description: Top edge, metres from the top of the drawing.

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).
